finalText:
All objectives are complete. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** A project named `tbp6 MTP Bench Project` exists in the app. It was created with status Open (first instance id `3zfkrmb5rf`). Note: that first instance later vanished from the server mid-run (verified via the app's own `get-projects` response — 404 on its id, absent from both active and closed lists), so I recreated the project under the same exact name (id `p1ncj2s7k6`) to leave the required project in place, and closed it per Objective 6.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Line item `tbp6 MTP Item A`, cost 100, markup (Margin %) 25. Computed price displayed: **133.33** (raw value 133.3333333333 — the app computes price = cost / (1 − markup/100) = 100 / 0.75).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Line item `tbp6 MTP Item B`, cost 200, markup 25. Computed price displayed: **266.67** (raw value 266.6666666666 = 200 / 0.75).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Item A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). Computed price afterwards: **200.00** (raw value 199.99999999995 = 150 / 0.75).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Item A's status changed from its initial status `Placeholder` to `Specified`. Preconditions the app enforced, discovered from its refusal message **"Cannot save — please complete or correct: Supplier, Supplier Code, Item Units, Unit"**:
- Supplier Code, Item Units, and Unit had to be filled (I set Supplier Code, Item Units = 1, Unit = "item").
- The **Supplier** field is an autocomplete (endpoint `/_api/api/auto-suppliers`) that rejects free-typed text ("Please enter a value for this item") and requires selecting an existing organisation record. I typed "Supplier" and selected **"Supplier One" (code SUP1)** from the dropdown, which auto-filled Supplier Code to SUP1.
After that the save succeeded with no errors, and the list showed the item with Status: **Specified** (name, cost 150, and markup 25 unchanged).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both line items were removed (Item A via context menu → "Remove Project Item" → confirmed "Remove this project item?"; Item B was already gone). Verified by searching the Project Items list for "tbp6" and "MTP Item": 0 matching rows, and no items belonging to `tbp6 MTP Bench Project` remain (7 rows total, all belonging to fixture/q7k projects). The project `tbp6 MTP Bench Project` (id `p1ncj2s7k6`) was set from status Open to **Closed** via its edit panel: it no longer appears in the active Projects list and appears only when "Include Closed" is checked. Nothing created by this run is left active.
